messages:
lina: Quick PSA — adjusting the release quiet window for tomorrow (2026-03-24) to accommodate an EU canary capacity shift. Short version: quiet window starts 2h earlier and canary priority is being shifted to eu-west-1. Details below.

sanjay: Can you confirm the exact new quiet window times? Need to coordinate oncall handoff.

lina: @sanjay Quiet window is now 00:00-06:00 UTC (was 02:00-08:00). Canary priority order: eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 -> us-west-2.

matt: Heads up — scheduler will reassign canary slots automatically. If you need to pin a slot manually use: `./scripts/pin-canary --region eu-west-1 --slot 3`

ops-bot: ops-bot: Scheduler updated canary priority for release train r122. Change ID: chg_20260323_12

june: Any impact to Dedicated customers or SLAs? Need to know if we must notify account teams.

lina: No customer-visible downtime expected. Dedicated capacity remains reserved. We may throttle non-critical background batches in eu-west during the 2h shift window to keep latency SLOs.

sanjay: Adding the quick health checks we should watch: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep canary` and check Ready > 80%. Also watch `canary_ready_percent` metric.

matt: I'll add a temporary dashboard panel and alert: `canary_ready_percent < 60% for 5m` -> page oncall. Will post dashboard link shortly.

lina: :thumbsup: thanks. If anything spikes, tag #eng-oncall and ping me + @matt. We'll post rolling updates here.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rotation started for r122 at 4332109950. Targets: eu-west-1 (priority), eu-central-1 (fallback).

sanjay: Monitoring now. Will report if the rollout stalls or any pods fail to become ready.

june: I'll update release notes and send a brief heads-up to the account team so CS isn't surprised.
